Looking at the sequence: `< < { } >`

Let me track the open brackets:
- `<` - opens 1st angle bracket
- `<` - opens 2nd angle bracket  
- `{` - opens curly brace
- `}` - closes curly brace ✓
- `>` - closes 2nd angle bracket

This leaves the 1st angle bracket unclosed, so we need one more `>`:

**< < { } > >**

ANSWER: < < { } > >
